summary: TScan Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce positive initial data from Cohort C of the ALLOHA Phase 1 study evaluating TSC-101 in heme malignancies. The filing includes a press release and updated company presentation. It reports a ~90% manufacturing success rate, chimerism data, and safety profile. This is a routine clinical update, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic event are involved.
